# The market-data feed

Official market data (ECB FX reference rates, US Treasury par curve, SOFR, euro short-term rate).

The ECB's euro foreign exchange reference rates, the US Treasury par yield curve, SOFR from the New York Fed and the euro short-term rate from the ECB, in the market-data pack's own shapes (fx-spot, ir-curve, rate-fixing).

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | European Central Bank, U.S. Department of the Treasury, Federal Reserve Bank of New York (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates) |
| Licence | [ECB reuse with attribution; US Treasury public domain; New York Fed terms (attribution)](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/home/disclaimer/html/index.en.html): redistributable with attribution |
| Attribution | Source: European Central Bank; U.S. Department of the Treasury; Federal Reserve Bank of New York |
| Lake | `capitalmarket` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | weekdays at 18:30 (local time) |
| Pull | `official_market_data.MarketDataFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/official_market_data.py); 0.5 s between requests, 3 retries |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run market-data --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run market-data                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/market-data/<date>/, load into capitalmarket
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status market-data             # its last runs
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### fx-spot

Pack `market-data`, kind `fx-spot` (FX spot rate), table `fx-spot`, key `PAIR`; files `data/datafeeds/market-data/<date>/fx-spot.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the business date the source gives it.

An ECB euro reference rate.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PAIR` | id | required | The record's id: FX- and the pair, base then quote currency (FX-AUDUSD). |
| `PAIR_NAME` | text | required | The pair as people write it, BASE/QUOTE (EUR/USD). |
| `MID` | amount | required | The mid spot rate: units of the quote currency per one unit of the base (the last HISTORY point). |
| `BID` | amount | required | The bid spot rate, in quote currency per one unit of the base. |
| `ASK` | amount | required | The ask (offer) spot rate, in quote currency per one unit of the base. |
| `CHANGE_1D` | amount | required | The day's move of MID, as a fraction (-0.01092 is -1.092%). |
| `SPOT_DATE` | date | required | The spot value date: two business days after the data's date (T+2). |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The daily mids, oldest first: one object per business day. |
| `CONVENTIONS` | record | required | The pair's market conventions: base and quote currency, pip factor, spot lag, settlement calendars, NDF or not. |
| `FX_FORWARD_CURVE` | id | required | Its forward curve: a CURVE_ID of the market-data pack's fx-forward-curve kind (FXF-…). |
| `FX_VOL_SURFACE` | id | required | Its volatility surface: a SURFACE_ID of the market-data pack's fx-vol-surface kind (FXV-…). |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"PAIR": "FX-AUDUSD", "PAIR_NAME": "AUD/USD", "MID": 0.661, "BID": 0.66097, "ASK": 0.66103, "CHANGE_1D": -0.01092, "SPOT_DATE": "2026-10-02", "FX_FORWARD_CURVE": "FXF-AUDUSD", "FX_VOL_SURFACE": "FXV-AUDUSD"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/banking/market-data/contracts/fx-spot.contract.yaml` ([market-data](../../docs/contracts/packs/market-data.md)).

### ir-curve

Pack `market-data`, kind `ir-curve` (Interest rate curve), table `ir-curve`, key `CURVE_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/market-data/<date>/ir-curve.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the business date the source gives it.

The US Treasury par yield curve.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CURVE_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `CURRENCY` | text | required | The curve's currency, ISO 4217. |
| `CURVE_TYPE` | text | required | What the curve is for: Discount (OIS), Projection, Government or Cross-currency basis. |
| `INDEX` | text | required | The overnight rate the currency's curves are built on (SOFR, ESTR, SONIA, TONA, SARON, AONIA, CORRA). |
| `TEN_Y` | amount | required | The 10-year zero rate, as a fraction (0.0422 is 4.22%). |
| `SLOPE_2S_10S` | amount | required | The 10-year zero rate minus the 2-year, in basis points. |
| `AS_OF` | date | required | The date the curve was built for (the business date). |
| `POINTS` | record list | required | The curve's pillars, shortest tenor first: one object per tenor (1M to 30Y). |
| `FORWARDS` | record list | required | One-year forward rates starting at each tenor (1Y to 20Y): one object per start tenor. |
| `INTERPOLATION` | text | required | How the curve interpolates between pillars (e.g. Log-linear on discount factors). |
| `DAY_COUNT` | text | required | The day-count convention of the zero rates (e.g. ACT/365F). |
| `CALENDAR` | id | required | The curve's holiday calendar: a CALENDAR_ID of the core pack's calendar kind (CAL-…). |
| `FIXING_INDEX` | id | required | The overnight index's fixings: an INDEX_ID of the market-data pack's rate-fixing kind (FIX-…). |
| `BUILT_AT` | timestamp | required | When the curve was built, ISO-8601 UTC. |
| `SOURCES` | text list | required | The quote sources the curve was built from. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"CURVE_ID": "CRV-AUD-BASIS", "CURRENCY": "AUD", "CURVE_TYPE": "Cross-currency basis", "INDEX": "AONIA", "TEN_Y": 0.042199999999999994, "SLOPE_2S_10S": 51.2, "AS_OF": "2026-09-30", "INTERPOLATION": "Log-linear on discount factors", "DAY_COUNT": "ACT/365F", "CALENDAR": "CAL-GBLO", "FIXING_INDEX": "FIX-AONIA", "BUILT_AT": "2026-09-30T18:02:41Z"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/banking/market-data/contracts/ir-curve.contract.yaml` ([market-data](../../docs/contracts/packs/market-data.md)).

### rate-fixing

Pack `market-data`, kind `rate-fixing` (Rate index fixings), table `rate-fixing`, key `INDEX_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/market-data/<date>/rate-fixing.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the business date the source gives it.

SOFR and the euro short-term rate.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INDEX_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `NAME` | text | required | The rate index's full name (Secured Overnight Financing Rate …). |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | The latest fixing (FIXINGS[0].RATE), as a fraction (0.03806 is 3.806%). |
| `ADMINISTRATOR` | text | required | The index administrator (FRBNY, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan, SIX, RBA, Bank of Canada). |
| `TENOR` | text | required | The index tenor (Overnight). |
| `CURRENCY` | text | required | The currency of the overnight rate, ISO 4217. |
| `FIXINGS` | record list | required | The daily fixings, latest first: one object per publication day. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"INDEX_ID": "FIX-AONIA", "NAME": "AUD Overnight Index Average", "LATEST": 0.03806, "ADMINISTRATOR": "RBA", "TENOR": "Overnight", "CURRENCY": "AUD"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/banking/market-data/contracts/rate-fixing.contract.yaml` ([market-data](../../docs/contracts/packs/market-data.md)).
